repairProposalForConference.status: NEW alternative, not selected or applied
repairProposalForConference.maximumAllocation: Exact rational mass shares. Floor each maximum quota; assign remaining units in descending fractional remainder order, ties by immutable predeclared piece ID.
repairProposalForConference.currentAllocation: Floor each current quota. Allocate remaining units in descending current fractional remainder order, same tie rule, skipping pieces at their assigned maximum. Iterate the stable order only if still needed; capacities total enough because original current<=maximum.
repairProposalForConference.historyScope: Actual physical partition must already be lawful. Persist parent/child IDs, masses and chosen ordering. Zero-maximum fragments remain material, not operational finished items. No newly inferred cutting,repair,consumption or stock-generation permission.
repairProposalForConference.invariantArgument: For each positive mass share andC<=H, floor(Cshare)<=floor(Hshare)<=assignedMaximum. The available capacities sum toH-sum(floor(Cshare)), at least the remaining C-sum(floor(Cshare)) units. Bounded allocation therefore preserves totals and never exceeds any maximum. No numerical balance claim.
repairProposalForConference.notSettled: Whether this apportionment is the intended game rule, operation-order and repair consequences require the Creation conference. It is a concrete alternative to discuss, not a new accepted interface.

nonAssociativity.selection: Actual irreversible cut history controls. No global reallocation among existing detached leaves.

mergeDamageBoundary.afterOrdinaryBundleOrMendingRejoin: Exactly the same three independent leaves and damage values. Bundling has no new HP pool. Any later physical cut operates on actual leaves, not original root totals.

proof: For positive exact weights, floor(Cw_i)<=floor(Mw_i)<=assignedMaximum_i, so current floors fit.

Residual current capacity totals M-sum(currentFloors), at least C-sum(currentFloors). Every successful increment decreases a finite nonnegative remainder; stable scan therefore terminates within capacity.

Each actual subdivision preserves parent sums. A finite local tree preserves root totals by telescoping. This is not an associativity proof and does not authorize cutting, repairing, pricing or ingredients.
zeroMaximumMeaning: Physical material persists; zero/zero does not become a new functional finished item. A later genuine source may manufacture using the actual material with actual costs; no free repair by merge.
